questions.question: ¿Cuándo usas "How much"?
questions.answer: Con sustantivos incontables (water, money, time) o para preguntar precios.

questions.question: ¿Cuándo usas "How many"?
questions.answer: Con sustantivos contables que tienen plural (books, students, days).

questions.question: Estructura de pregunta con How much
questions.answer: How much + sustantivo incontable + do/does + sujeto + verbo?

questions.question: Estructura de pregunta con How many
questions.answer: How many + sustantivo contable plural + do/does + sujeto + verbo?

questions.question: ¿Cuándo se usa "Which" en vez de "What"?
questions.answer: Cuando hay un conjunto definido/limitado de opciones frente a ti.

questions.question: Estructura de pregunta con Which
questions.answer: Which + sustantivo/one + do/does + sujeto + verbo?

questions.question: ¿Cómo preguntas con "Who" cuando es sujeto?
questions.answer: Who + verbo (sin DO/DOES) — ej. Who goes to school?

questions.question: ¿Cómo preguntas con "Who" cuando es objeto?
questions.answer: Who + do/does + sujeto + verbo — ej. Who do you like?

questions.question: Estructura de sugerencia afirmativa con Let's
questions.answer: Let's + verbo base sin to — ej. Let's go!

questions.question: Estructura de sugerencia negativa con Let's
questions.answer: Let's not + verbo base — ej. Let's not worry.

questions.question: ¿Cómo preguntas por el clima?
questions.answer: What's the weather like? / How's the weather today?

questions.question: Estructura para describir el clima con adjetivo
questions.answer: It's + adjetivo — ej. It's cold.

questions.question: Estructura para describir el clima en progreso
questions.answer: It's + verbo -ing — ej. It's raining / It's snowing.

questions.question: ¿Por qué siempre se necesita "it" en oraciones de clima?
questions.answer: Porque el clima en inglés siempre requiere el sujeto "it"; no se omite como en español.

questions.question: Traduce: soleado
questions.answer: sunny

questions.question: Traduce: nublado
questions.answer: cloudy

questions.question: Traduce: ventoso
questions.answer: windy

questions.question: Traduce: templado/agradable
questions.answer: warm

questions.question: Traduce: fresco
questions.answer: cool

questions.question: Traduce: está nevando
questions.answer: it's snowing

questions.question: Corrige: "How many money do you have?"
questions.answer: How much money do you have? (money es incontable)

questions.question: Corrige: "How much brothers do you have?"
questions.answer: How many brothers do you have? (brothers es contable)

questions.question: Corrige: "What one do you prefer?"
questions.answer: Which one do you prefer? (hay opciones específicas)

questions.question: Corrige: "Who does go to school early?"
questions.answer: Who goes to school early? (who sujeto no lleva DO/DOES)

questions.question: Corrige: "Let's to go to the park!"
questions.answer: Let's go to the park! (verbo base sin to)

questions.question: Corrige: "Is raining outside."
questions.answer: It's raining outside. (sujeto it obligatorio)

questions.question: Traduce: ¿Cuántas materias tienes este semestre?
questions.answer: How many subjects do you have this semester?

questions.question: Traduce: ¿Cuánto cuesta el uniforme?
questions.answer: How much does the uniform cost?

questions.question: Traduce: ¿Cuál autobús va al centro, el rojo o el verde?
questions.answer: Which bus goes to the center, the red one or the green one?

questions.question: Traduce: No lleguemos tarde, la clase empieza a las 7
questions.answer: Let's not be late, class starts at 7.
